periodontitis: rag_llm-Target condition: This sample belongs to subject ind10 in the study, identified as individual #10. Cross-referencing Table 1 (Characteristics of the study population) in the user_uploaded_file shows that patient #10 is located in the T2D−P− group (healthy controls with neither type 2 diabetes nor periodontitis). The target condition for this sample is therefore 'no periodontitis' or 'none' (unaffected/control status). Per CROSS-FIELD CONSISTENCY rules, since this sample is in the control/unaffected group, the condition field must reflect absence of disease. [Sources: user_uploaded_file (Table 1, 'T2D-P- #3 Female 59 – – 32 0 12'); NCBI_bioproject (description, 'four study groups based on presence/absence of poorly controlled type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and moderate-severe periodontitis')] [Conflict: none]

no: rag_llm-Control status: Sample ind10 (subject #3 in the T2D−P− group per Table 1) has no history of periodontitis and no type 2 diabetes diagnosis, meeting the full criteria for the unaffected/reference group. This sample is a control (fully unaffected group with none of the study's conditions/exposures present). [Sources: user_uploaded_file (Table 1, T2D-P- group row; Materials & Methods section 2.2.1.4, 'no history of type 2 diabetes diagnosis; no history of periodontitis')] [Conflict: none]
